@dmpt-welcome-par1: Thank you for registering a research data management plan. If you've submitted a research project proposal in Research Master, we should have pre-filled parts of this form for you, where possible. However, research evolves, so it is a good idea to make sure that the pre-fills are correct.
@dmpt-welcome-par2: Providing this information will help put you in touch with services that can help you store or analyse your research data and allow you to collaborate online with colleagues. Your data management plan, if kept up to date, will satisfy the requirements of ReDBox policy and most research funder requirements. If your funder has specific requirements beyond the scope of this plan, please contact the eResearch Data Librarian on support@redboxresearchdata.com.au for help.
@dmpt-welcome-par3: Your plan will also lay the foundation for a catalogue of your research data, ensuring that you (and ReDBox) can meet the data governance responsibilities as required by the Code for the Responsible Conduct of Research, by being able to locate and access the data as required.
@dmpt-welcome-par4: If you require any assistance completing your plan, please contact us via support@redboxresearchdata.com.au.

@dmpt-project-activity-type-help:
Select the Type of Research Activity associated with the research that you are undertaking. The Research Activity Type is in line with the Australian and New Zealand Standard Research Classification (ANZSRC) 2008.
  • Pure basic research is experimental and theoretical work undertaken to acquire new knowledge without looking for long term benefits other than the advancement of knowledge.
  • Strategic basic research is experimental and theoretical work undertaken to acquire new knowledge directed into specified broad areas in the expectation of useful discoveries. It provides the broad base of knowledge necessary for the solution of recognised practical problems.
  • Applied research is original work undertaken primarily to acquire new knowledge with a specific application in view. It is undertaken either to determine possible uses for the findings of basic research or to determine new ways of achieving some specific and predetermined objectives.
  • Experimental development is systematic work, using existing knowledge gained from research or practical experience, that is directed to producing new materials, products or devices, to installing new processes, systems and services, or to improving substantially those already produced or installed.
@dmpt-project-anzsrcFor-help: Select the Field of Research code associated with your research project. Information on the Fields of Research classification codes can be found at http://www.arc.gov.au/applicants/codes.htm#FOR.
@dmpt-project-anzsrcSeo-help: Select the Socio-Economic Objective associated with your research project. Information on the Socio-Economic Objective classification codes can be found at http://www.arc.gov.au/applicants/codes.htm#SEO.

For example, will you be using quantitative data collection methods whereby you will collect and analyse data samples? Will you use qualitative collection methods such as interviews and focus groups? Will you stage the collection of your data? Will your data collection methods follow a repeatable and verifiable process? Will an external service or group be used for your data collection activities?

@dmpt-vivo:Dataset_redbox:DataCollection: Software/equipment used to create/collect the data

List the software or equipment that you intend to use to create and collect your research data. If a service has been used to collect data, please provide details. For software, please list the software title, version number, operating system, and any other parameters needed to operate the software. For equipment, please list the equipment brand, model number, and any parameters or settings required.
@dmpt-vivo:Dataset_redbox:DataAnalysisRe: Software/equipment used to manipulate/analyse the data

List the software or equipment that you intend to use to analyse or manipulate your research data. If a service has been used to analyse data, please provide details. For software, please list the software title, version number, operating system, and any other parameters needed to operate the software. For equipment, please list the equipment brand, model number, and any parameters or settings required.
@dmpt-vivo:Dataset_redbox:MetadataStanda: List any metadata standards or schemas to be used  (e.g. Dublin Core, Darwin Core, etc)

Provide details of the metadata standard that will be applied to your research data. Metadata standards are requirements which are intended to establish a common understanding of the meaning or semantics of the data, to ensure correct and proper use and interpretation of the data by its owners and users. For example, the ANZLIC Metadata guidelines provide researchers with core metadata elements for geographic data in Australia and New Zealand.

named-query-date-days-help: Days is an integer offset from the time the query runs, converted to an ISO timestamp when a date operator is set. Use a negative value for earlier dates.
named-query-date-iso-help: ISODate passes an ISO timestamp through to the date comparison. Keep an explicit format or template override when required.
named-query-invalid-json: Enter a valid JSON object or array of the expected type.
named-query-foreign-guidance: Foreign record guidance (separate from the local query)
named-query-guidance-unavailable: Guidance unavailable. Manual editing remains available.
named-query-validation-unavailable: Validation unavailable. Your draft is retained.
named-query-pending-input: Apply or correct pending JSON edits before saving or previewing.
named-query-guidance-only: Guidance changes suggestions only. It never changes query conditions or the saved definition.
named-query-scope-notice: These suggestions describe the selected type and stage only. Other types and historical records returned by this query may have a different shape.
named-query-type-effect: This action ANDs the following condition with the existing query, preserving all current predicates:
named-query-choose-guidance-help: Choose a record type for metadata suggestions, or keep editing with envelope fields only.
named-query-field-insertion-help: Use “Choose a field” beside an input to insert its correct path with the keyboard. Metadata paths, mapping paths and Handlebars expressions have separate contexts.
named-query-manual-collection: Manual editing is available for this collection. Record schemas do not describe user or custom collections.
named-query-real-data: Preview is explicit and reads real data using your current permissions. Results are bounded by server limits.
named-query-preview-refused: Preview was refused. Review the blocking diagnostics below or beside the affected field. User/custom collections, related filters and relation expansion are unsupported in draft preview; editing and saving remain available.
named-query-truncated: Preview was truncated by the server. Limit reason:
report-add-selected-columns: Add columns from selected output fields
report-array-help: This field is an array. Enable multivalue to render each item, or handle the whole array explicitly in a template. Array item paths cannot be used as direct column lookups.
report-assistance-unavailable: Query assistance is unavailable. You can continue editing manually and refresh assistance later.
report-columns-help: Choose output fields in the help panel to add columns explicitly. Labels, order, visibility and templates remain editable.
report-confirm-date-pair: Use this From / To parameter pair?
report-csv-context-help: CSV templates receive the result row, recordTableMeta.col, recordTableMeta.val (the selected scalar, whole array or each multivalue item), and optTemplateData.brandingAndPortalUrl. An empty export template falls back to the display template.
report-date-binding-help: From and To contain query parameter names, not record field paths. Date inputs send ISO timestamps; parameters expecting a number of days are incompatible. Unlisted legacy bindings remain editable.
report-display-context-help: Display templates receive the result row, recordTableMeta.col and optTemplateData.brandingAndPortalUrl. recordTableMeta.val is undefined for scalar display columns; multivalue columns supply each item. Use a row path for a scalar display value.
report-export-preview-help: CSV values include hidden columns and spreadsheet formula protection, before CSV quoting.
report-filter-binding-help: Text filters pass their parameter name to the query. Choose a suggested name or enter a custom binding. Suggestions never replace existing bindings.
report-loading-assistance: Loading query parameters and output fields…
report-preview-no-deadline: This query uses a compatibility execution path without an enforced database deadline. Row, rendering and response limits still apply.
report-preview-real-data: Preview runs only when you select Preview. It uses real data, the current unsaved columns and templates, and the filter values entered below.
report-preview-refused: Preview could not execute this draft. Review the diagnostics; preview restrictions do not change the save contract.
report-preview-truncated: Preview is truncated by the server. Limits reached:
report-query-change-help: Changing the named query keeps your filters, columns and templates. Review diagnostics for bindings or output fields that no longer exist.
report-request-failed: The report request failed. Please try again.
report-search-output-fields: Search output fields by label or path
report-validation-unavailable: Draft validation is unavailable. Manual editing and saving remain available.
report-query-choices-unavailable: Query choices are unavailable for this session. Enter a saved query name to load its parameters and output fields.
